sentences.en: He seems rough, but at heart he is very gentle.
sentences.zh: 他看起来很粗鲁，但内心其实非常温柔。

sentences.en: We had a rough crossing on an old ferry.
sentences.zh: 我们在一艘旧渡轮上经历了一次颠簸的航行。

sentences.en: The surface of the peculiar object is fairly rough.
sentences.zh: 这个奇特物体的表面相当粗糙。

senses.zh: 粗糙的；粗野的；未经加工的
